svg.title: Persistent Domain Classes - Actual ORM Structure

g.text: Persistent Domain Classes - Actual ORM Structure
Ordered by day DESC, id DESC.
kind: baseline | hbp | depre | psqi (application catalog).
No FK to User: identifiers may exist without accounts.
Record ownership is enforced by request handling.
kind: hbp | depre | age; ordered by id DESC.
Source artifact: engine, path, feature_names, form_version,
scores: fold accuracies in percent for the web trainer.
available: source path exists within BASE_DIR;
non-source artifacts return true without file checks.
mean_accuracy = average(scores), or null if empty.
pk=1 is a singleton convention, not a DB constraint.
No database FK or automatic cascade for JSON model IDs.
Unknown usernames can also have attempts.
Time expiry is evaluated on a subsequent login request.
Administrator password reset deletes the matching attempt.
Solid arrow with multiplicities: implemented foreign-key association.
Dashed arrow: dependency / logical lookup, not a foreign key.
Fields shown for Django User are a relevant subset; portal fields are complete.
